title: Term Life Insurance Policy Fee Share in the Grace Remittance for Holders of Whole Life and Universal Life Insurance
content:
**Customer terms — Term Life Insurance.** In the newly due installment counted in a grace remittance, the share of the policy fee charged follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies, as the owner's Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policy records show them:

- the owner holds both an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy — **nothing** of the fee is charged;
- the owner holds exactly one of the two in force — **one half** (0.5) of the fee is charged;
- otherwise — the **whole** of the fee is charged.

| Whole Life Insurance in force | Universal Life Insurance in force | Share charged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | nothing |
| yes | no | one half |
| no | yes | one half |
| no | no | the whole fee |

Only policies whose status is in force count. Hypothetical: a policy fee of 70.00 before the share is charged at 35.00 to an owner holding one in-force Ashgrove Accumulation UL and no whole life policy.
